projects.title: Synchronous Buck Converter for a CubeSat Power Board
bullets: Reached 92% peak efficiency at a 2 A load, measured on an electronic load, by replacing the catch diode with a synchronous MOSFET stage and tuning dead time with an STM32 timer
Cut output ripple from 80 mV to 25 mV peak to peak, measured on an oscilloscope, by redesigning the 4-layer PCB in KiCad with a solid ground plane and a tighter switching loop
Wrote STM32 firmware in C that shuts the rail down within 50 µs of an overcurrent fault, verified over 20 deliberate short-circuit tests

projects.title: FPGA Audio Equalizer
bullets: Processed 48 kHz stereo audio at under 2 ms latency by pipelining five 64-tap FIR filters in Verilog
Matched the MATLAB reference response within 0.5 dB from 20 Hz to 20 kHz by testing fixed-point coefficients in Vivado simulation

projects.title: Bluetooth Battery Monitor
bullets: Tracked four Li-ion cells to within 10 mV each with an ESP32 monitor that streams readings over Bluetooth to a Python dashboard
Measured pack current within 1% of a bench multimeter by calibrating an INA219 sensor across a 0.1 A to 3 A load sweep
Extended field-test runtime by 18% by adding a low-voltage cutoff in C++ that sheds non-critical loads at 3.3 V per cell

experience.title: Power Subsystem Lead
bullets: Cut power board mass by 40 g by replacing three linear regulators with one buck converter board
Found two battery protection faults before launch review by writing a Python script that runs overnight charge and discharge cycles and flags cell drift
Led weekly design reviews for a four-person power team and kept board revisions on schedule for two launch-readiness milestones
